einzeiler: Dave Franco on his career, family background, and creative projects
kurzfassung: Dave Franco discusses his experiences growing up as the youngest of three brothers and building an independent career in Hollywood. He talks about his work on projects like Idiots and The Studio alongside host Dax Shepard. The conversation also covers personal topics including relationships, vulnerability, and avoiding social media.
stichpunkte: Growing up as the youngest of three brothers
Pursuing the project Idiots for a decade
Working on the long takes of The Studio
Forging an identity outside of his brother's shadow
The role of vulnerability and staying off social media
beschreibung:
Dave Franco (Idiots, The Studio, Together) is an actor, writer, and director. Dave returns to Armchair Expert to discuss growing up as the youngest of three brothers, being a hopeless romantic from childhood, and becoming Hollywood’s sexiest cat dad. Dave and Dax talk about pursuing Idiots for a decade, surviving the exhausting long takes of The Studio, and forging an identity outside his brother’s shadow. Dave explains why vulnerability is worth the risk, why he stays off social media, and why the right relationship gets better with time.
